decisions.decision: Guarantee the resume with a TEST, not a note
decisions.rationale: BACK-A11Y-01 was invisible ~3 months after a v5.0 archive; BACK-89 drifted P2->P1 invisible for 3.5 months; v5.24 slipped three boundaries. In every case the work WAS written down — writing it down is what failed.

decisions.decision: 999.113 D1 — every ratio divides by the population its own numerator is drawn from
decisions.rationale: Not a new principle: agility_high_impact_ratio already did it, and _endpoints_assessed's docstring already instructed it. 34 sites were inconsistent with the one site and the one docstring that already said it.

decisions.decision: 999.113 D1(d) — agility_high_impact_ratio ALSO had the defect
decisions.rationale: Orchestrator initially and wrongly fenced it off as 'the one site that was always correct'. It divided 19 high-impact findings by 398 TOTAL findings, 330 of them INFO. Found by arithmetic during implementation, not by inspection.

decisions.decision: 999.113 D5 — do not tune to a target
decisions.rationale: The lab score must move because the denominator became meaningful, not because someone picked a number that demos well. Held: the executor reported 87 against a <40 target and changed no weights.

decisions.decision: Choose the next scoring model BY MEASUREMENT, not argument
decisions.rationale: Attempt #1 (Phase 188 SCORE-06) failed because nothing could tell whether a change had helped — ~3,200 lines of scoring tests were green the whole time the score was blind.

next_action: Build the scoring property suite P1-P6 in tests/, red-proved against current main so P1/P2/P4/P6 demonstrably FAIL today. P4 (dynamic range) encodes 'the multihost reference estate scores below 40' and must fail at 87 — that failing test IS the deliverable.
context_notes: Operator explicitly instructed: 'lets pick up at the property suite p1-p6 when resuming'. The strategic frame that matters: the existing scoring suite asserts mechanism, bounds and rendering but never MEANING — test_score_always_bounded_1000_iterations is passed perfectly by a function returning the constant 91. The property suite is the missing test class and the instrument that makes every subsequent model decision measurable. Do not start by picking a model shape.
